release.title: Kaes Keid Inspector
release.tagline: The definitive CSS/HTML & Technology Stack Inspector — free & open source.

sections.usage:
## Installation

1. Download **kaes-keide-inspector-v{version}.zip** from the assets of this Release.
2. Extract the archive into a local folder.
3. Open `chrome://extensions/` or `edge://extensions/`.
4. Enable **Developer mode**.
5. Click **Load unpacked** and select the extracted folder.
sections.extra:
## Other installation details

The published archive contains the compiled content of `dist/` directly. No Node.js, npm, or local build step is required.
